title: A "DECISION: none" line in a report is pinned as an owner question
body:
A worker's RESULT.md had the line `DECISION: none. No owner decision is needed for this PR.` The mod pinned it for the owner as D3 and pinged the owner.

- Expected: a DECISION line that says "none" (or has no question and no options) is not pinned.
- Actual: it was pinned as an owner question. The coordinator had to unpin it with `decided`.
- Workaround: briefs now say "no DECISION line at all".

Fix: skip DECISION lines whose text starts with "none" (case-insensitive), or require the `question | option | option` form before a line is pinned.
